problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize f on C, with ConvexOn ℝ C f and closed constrained epigraph; a minimizer exists.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact ball-minimization oracle: at feasible x, returns y in C with ‖y−x‖≤t minimizing f over C∩B(x,t). Only the point y is returned. Every history and seed must satisfy this condition.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its induced norm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public t>0, R≥0, Δ>0, ε>0 and feasible x0; some hidden minimizer xstar satisfies ‖x0−xstar‖≤R and f(x0)−f(xstar)≤Δ. C and f are hidden. No smoothness assumption. The allowed algorithm repeatedly replaces its state by the oracle reply.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The final output belongs to C and satisfies f(output)−f(xstar)≤ε for a minimizer xstar.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Feasibility and objective-gap accuracy hold almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Convex minimization with an exact local ball-minimization oracle is a meaningful specialized oracle formulation; each call solves an entire constrained optimization subproblem.
